pages.name: Sign up
lines: Create a workspace with an account you already have.

pages.name: Agent Wallets
lines: Create an agent. It gets a wallet of its own, empty until you fund it.
Fund its wallet from the workspace’s balance. The agent can spend only what its wallet holds.
Issue the agent its own key: a proxy key that spends only this agent’s balance, under its rules. It is shown once.
Watch its statement: every request the agent makes is a line with what it cost and the balance left.
Create an agent, fund its wallet and take funds back.
Issue the agent a key that spends only its own balance, under its rules.
Set its spending rules: a payment past a limit is refused, and one above the approval amount waits in your approvals inbox, approved with a passkey once you have one.
Pause one agent, or stop every agent with one switch.
Read and download each wallet’s statement.
Agents pay each other and hold money in escrow.

pages.name: Setup
lines: Give the agent that key and the base URL Setup prints for Claude Code, Cursor, Continue or the OpenAI SDK.

pages.name: Talyvor in Claude
lines: Connect Claude, so it can read your accounts and prepare payments that you approve in Talyvor.

pages.name: Documentation
lines: Every wallet route Lens answers, with what each one does.

pages.name: Talyvor
lines: Each agent gets a wallet of its own: you fund it, the agent spends only what it holds, and its statement is every payment against it.
Talyvor checks your rules before an agent's payment moves.
Talyvor's email address is hello@talyvor.com. We answer by email.

pages.name: Approvals
lines: A payment above an agent's approval amount waits in your approvals inbox until you approve or decline it.
You approve with a passkey once you have one.

pages.name: Help and complaints
lines: Ask us about your account, or tell us what went wrong. A person at Talyvor reads every message and answers on this page.
A complaint gets a reference as soon as you send it. Quote it whenever you write to us about it.

pages.name: Close this account
lines: Before the account can close, every balance must be empty: the account's own, each agent's, and any money set aside. Move the money out first.
A person at Talyvor closes the account and answers on this page. Only the account's owner can ask.

pages.name: Your data
lines: Ask for a copy of this account's data, or ask Talyvor to delete it. A person at Talyvor handles each request. Only the account's owner can ask.
When your copy is ready, Download appears beside your request.
Billing and ledger records, statements included, are kept as the law requires.
Help chats are kept for 30 days and are listed on this page, where you can delete yours. Your Help chat is yours alone: no one else in the account sees it.
